note.zh: 调查后10–30天随机揭晓其一；机械体只在合约方为机械/机器人帝国时，未经授权的生物货物对部分好战或排外帝国不出现。
note.en: Investigating reveals one at random after 10-30 days; the mechanoid needs a machine/robot issuer, and the unauthorized biological cargo is excluded for some militarist or xenophobic empires.
